content.text: {"id": "mm7336a3", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Safety of PCV21 among 4,020 recipients was compared with that among 2,018 recipients"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Safety data from four PCV21 phase III clinical trials ( 11 , 13 – 15 ) were pooled"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The proportion of participants who experienced at least one solicited adverse event was comparable among PCV21 (63.3%) and comparator vaccine (63.9%) recipients."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "serious adverse events were observed in 74 (1.5%) of 4,963 PCV21 recipients"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "serious adverse events were observed in 74 (1.5%) of 4,963 PCV21 recipients"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The proportion of participants who experienced at least one solicited adverse event was comparable among PCV21 (63.3%) and comparator vaccine (63.9%) recipients."}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "guidance or recommendations", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "ACIP recommended PCV21 as an option for adults aged ≥19 years"}]}, {"v": "review or synthesis", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "using the Grading of Recommendations, Assessment, Development and Evaluation (GRADE) approach"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Safety data from four PCV21 phase III clinical trials ( 11 , 13 – 15 ) were pooled"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "using the Grading of Recommendations, Assessment, Development and Evaluation (GRADE) approach"}, {"loc": "note", "q": "Defined as two-sided 95% CI of the pneumococcal serotype-specific OPA GMT ratio"}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["data_focus", "outcome_types"]}
